//: Firestore index source of truth. Deploy with `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes`. Single-field equality queries are automatic; composites are listed below.
//ttl: TTL policies are declared under fieldOverrides ("ttl": true), because the Firebase CLI lists every live TTL policy as a field override and, on `deploy --only firestore:indexes`, treats one missing from this file as a deletion (refused without --force; NEVER pass --force, it deletes the policy). Each override must also restate the field's live single-field indexes: an empty `indexes` there disables single-field indexing on the field. All three mirror the database default (ascending, descending, array-contains; `gcloud firestore indexes fields describe <field> --collection-group=<group>`), so a deploy against a project that already has them writes nothing. `challenges.expireAt`: consume_nonce deletes a nonce on use; TTL reclaims the ones never consumed.
//ttl-deleted: Deleted licences are held 30 days: `deleted_licenses.purgeAt` and `deleted_seats.purgeAt` (the seats under each) are TTL fields, declared in fieldOverrides (docs/backend/BACKEND_SETUP_CONSOLE.md step 3a). Without the policies a deleted licence is never purged; restore still refuses one past purgeAt.
//licenses: The staff desk lists licences newest first (createdAt DESC), filtered by mode unless Demo keys are shown and by status (an `in` filter) when revoked ones are hidden: repo/license_admin.list_licenses. One index per filter combination.
